_what: stratum-D sweep pack: where a FALSE-PASS would hide
draw_rule: BY CLIP FIRST — shuffle clips, one window per clip

mixed_in.note: blind ids come from the same shuffle, so a labeller cannot tell these from the sweep windows

sheet_design: unchanged, except panel A now states the overlay is NOT depth-tested
depth_note: -- NOT DEPTH-TESTED: a ground point BEHIND a raised object is drawn OVER it

C1 t0 footprint at the image bottom.bar: every front corner row >= 0.75 x H = 312

C2 far ground point on the horizon row.bar: monotone from below and |row(60) - horizon| <= 20.0 px

C3 the declared 120 deg field reaches bo.bar: the declared 120 deg field puts +-60 deg within 1 px of columns 0 and W-1

C4 +y is LEFT, asymmetry within the moun.bar: +y LEFT of centre, and asymmetry <= the bound this mount's own yaw and lateral offset imply (13.0 px)

rubric.on-surface: every part of the car stayed on roadway a car may drive on — including paint, markings and crosswalks painted ON the roadway
rubric.over-boundary: some part of the car crossed onto a surface that is not roadway — pavement, verge, traffic island, or past a raised kerb
rubric.cannot-tell: the images do not show the surface under the relevant part of the car well enough to decide

key_location: OUTSIDE the repo, held until the labels are landed
